ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the extent of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota and the impact of policy violations on the state's budget.
ideas.angle: Investigative reporting on Medicaid fraud and policy violations.
questions: What is the extent of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
How have policy violations impacted the state's budget?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant wrongdoing and shed light on the need for policy reform.
